mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: We are dedicated to creating products that push boundaries. Our goal is to provide cutting-edge software solutions and services, including consulting and support in the IT field. We are passionate about technology and committed to innovation.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: Three frontiers, one vision. We believe in the convergence of software engineering, artificial intelligence, and blockchain technology. Each of our products represents a different facet of this vision, brought to life with Swiss precision and bold innovation.

companyInfo.title: Company Information
companyInfo.legalFormValue: Limited Liability Company (Société à responsabilité limitée)

purpose.title: Our Purpose
purpose.content: The company's purpose is the development, marketing, operation, and trade of IT products. In addition, the company aims to provide services, particularly consulting and support services in the IT field. The company may establish branches and subsidiaries and may participate in other companies, both in Switzerland and abroad, and generally carry out any activity directly or indirectly related to its purpose.

team.title: Meet the Founders
team.subtitle: Three EPFL engineers building together since 2021, united by a passion for pushing the frontier of technology.

kamyar.name: Kamyar Taher
kamyar.bio: Full-stack engineer and AI systems architect with 5+ years shipping production web applications. Expert in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and high-performance 3D web experiences with Three.js and WebAssembly. Leads Clashware's technical vision, from pixel-perfect interfaces to multi-agent AI pipelines.

bastien.name: Bastien Faivre
bastien.bio: Distributed systems specialist focused on security and reliability. Contributed to BFT consensus engines and conducted performance evaluations of Layer 2 systems in collaboration with the Ethereum Foundation. Brings deep blockchain expertise to Clashware's products.

nils.name: Nils Delage
nils.bio: Full-stack developer with a strong focus on product development and infrastructure. Active in the blockchain ecosystem through EPFL's Blockchain Student Association. Drives Clashware's product engineering and platform architecture.
